text.p: - Aluminium producer Talum, the country's biggest consumer of electricity, accounted for 11.65 percent of Slovenia's total electricity consumption in 1995.
- More than 700 runners took part in the first Ljubljana Marathon on Sunday.
- Slovenia's third university is expected to be opened in Koper, 115 km (70 miles) southeast of Ljubljana, within the next three years.
- Slovenia on Saturday celebrated the fifth anniversary of the departure of the last soldier of the Yugoslav army after the country's brief war of independence in 1991.
- Slovenia's foreign exchange reserves rose by $460 million to $4.2 billion in August, the Bank of Slovenia said.
